## Two lives, one axis

**Anne Frank** (1929–1945) and **Martin Luther King Jr.** (1929–1968) were both born in 1929, so they are already aligned. The cards below put them on a single time axis, so the overlap is visible rather than asserted — and so is the silence afterwards.

**Marie** (1867–1934) and **Pierre Curie** (1859–1906) were born eight years apart, which is what the second card's **age alignment** is for: aligned at birth, their shared years line up and his lane ends at 46 while hers runs to 66.

Every event is a **structured Wikidata statement**: birth, death, education, posts, awards, residences. There is no date in Wikidata for the diary, the arrest, or the March on Washington — that is what the article prose holds. See `docs/LIFELINE-WIDGET.md`.
